title: tui: the board as the first screen, behind the tui feature, from bare foam
body: ratatui and crossterm behind the tui feature. One screen with what foam board shows: milestones, in progress, ready, blocked and the recent log, from one Store::load, with a selection cursor and q to quit. Bare foam opens it when stdin and stdout are terminals. Rows render through their own spans for now; fold into render.rs once it is clear what repeats.
close_reason: board screen behind the tui feature, bare foam opens it in a terminal; unit tests for rows, cursor and cutting, integration test for the piped case

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done: src/tui.rs behind the tui feature (default on) with ratatui 0.30, crossterm through ratatui's re-export. graph::board() now assembles the sections for both foam board and the screen. Rows are a flat list: headers, issue rows (selectable), a note when nothing is ready, and the recent log. Titles are cut with an ellipsis rather than wrapped; the tail (assignee, lease, waits on) gives way first down to a third of the room. Bare foam opens the screen only when stdin and stdout are terminals; piped it prints the usage and exits 2, same with --no-default-features.
